title: The railway to the mines
text: The Randsburg Railway ran 28.5 miles from Kramer Junction, on the Santa Fe main line, to Johannesburg, with a stop at Atolia. It opened in January 1898 as a supply link to the Rand Mine. The Santa Fe bought the railway in 1903. It ceased operations on December 30, 1933, a victim of the Great Depression and a decline in the mining industry.
